title: Abbas ek baar
body:
ek baar sada do na
maa keh ke pukaro na
ya abbas ya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt e ruqsat hussain ko bhai
jab alamdar ne kaha hoga
sochta hoo ke roohe zehra ne
roke us waqt ye kaha hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi maa keh de
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ko bhai tu ne kaha
bhai ka kiya armaan poora
armaan mera poora kar de abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
ay laal mere maa hone ka
har farz nibhaya hai maine
shabbir ke haathon se tujhko
jhoola bhi jhulaya hai maine
ehsaan tera hoga mujhpe abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi thi bohat phir bhi tujhse
is maa ko mohabbat thi itni
ek haath tha mera pehlu pe
ek haath se kurta seeti thi
sab zakhm mere bhar jayenge abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt gira tu ghode se
mai dekh rahi thi wo manzar
aaghosh mein tujhko rote huwe
maine hi sambhala tha bad kar
kab door hui hoo mai tujhse abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
bacchon ke liye jab darya se
mashkeeza bhara pani na piya
seh roz ka pyasa ho kar bhi
kya khoob nibhayi tu ne wafa
ay tashna dahan mere pyase abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
teri aankh se teer nikalun mai
tu dekhle bhai ka chehra
ye waqt e judaai hai dil mein
hasrat na rahe koi beta
aa khoon hata doon aankhon se abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein sakina pyasi hai
ye baat tujhe tadpati hai
is haal mein bhi tujhko haye
zainab ki rida yaad aati hai
aa tujhko laga loon seene se abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan sunaya ro ro kar
irfan e aza ne ye nauha
darya ke kanare ghazi ne
maa kehte huwe dum tod diya
zehra ne kaha jab ro ro ke abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
author: Zeeshan Abidi
